title: Source-bound business semantics review and record contract
description: Structural schema only. Runtime additionally verifies actual pinned ontology evidence, typed source projections, key uniqueness, reference closure, privacy, budgets and trusted approval. Never execute a review payload.

oneOf.description: Exact source-produced character and byte bounds; runtime validation also requires each end to be greater than or equal to its start.

value.$comment: business_semantics validates additional semantic constraints uniformly: exact decimal digits/scale, paired precision, source pin/anchor roles, unique references/priorities, composition closure, fixed-zone temporal decisions and property dimensions. Unknown optional forms fail closed.

currentReviewDiagnostics.description: Internal sealed current-review summary; only projected fields reach read_policy consumers. Not an accepted review record.
